title: Recognition of claims across data spaces

statement.en: Each claim type shall state its assurance level and its trust anchor, so that another data space can decide whether to accept or re-check the claim; recognition itself is not required.

control: The trust framework document states the assurance level and trust anchor of each claim type

expressions.note: Trust framework document checked by people.
Assurance level and trust anchor in the claim schema, readable by another data space.
